test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_cost_json (id UInt64, lc LowCardinality(String), j JSON) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
CREATE TABLE prewhere_cost_ends (k String, v String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
CREATE TABLE prewhere_cost_edit (a UInt32, s String CODEC(ZSTD(3))) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_cost_json SELECT number, if(intDiv(number, 200000) % 40 = 0, concat('v', toString(cityHash64(number, 1) % 2)), concat('v', toString(2 + cityHash64(number, 1) % 28))), if(intDiv(number, 200000) % 40 = 0, format('{{{{"k0":{{}},"k1":{{}}}}}}', toString(cityHash64(number, 2) % 5000000), toString(number % 1000)), format('{{{{"k1":{{}},"k2":{{}}}}}}', toString(number % 1000), toString(cityHash64(number, 3) % 1000000)))::JSON FROM numbers(30000000)

INSERT INTO prewhere_cost_ends SELECT concat('[AAAAAAAAAAAA][BBBBBBBBBBBB]-SPOT-CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC-K', leftPad(toString(intHash32(number) % 1000), 4, '0'), if(intHash32(number) % 1000 < 900, '@ZZZZZZ', '@YYYYYY')), if(intHash32(number) % 100 = 7 AND number % 3 = 0, 'p7', concat('p', toString(intHash64(number) % 500 + 10))) FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO prewhere_cost_edit SELECT toUInt32(cityHash64(number)), concat('k', toString(intDiv(number, 1000000) % 4), '-', repeat('ab-cd-', 5)) FROM numbers(12000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM prewhere_cost_json WHERE toUInt64OrZero(toString(j.k0)) = 1234567 AND lc IN ('v0', 'v1')
SELECT count() FROM prewhere_cost_ends WHERE k LIKE '%@ZZZZZZ' AND v = 'p7' SETTINGS optimize_rewrite_like_perfect_affix = 1
SELECT count() FROM prewhere_cost_edit WHERE editDistance(s, repeat('ab-dc-', 50)) > 3 AND a < 4294967
